preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h(si, sj) <= 10**5 for si in [s1, s2, s3, s4] for sj in [s1, s2, s3, s4] if si != sj)
preconditions.description: The Hamming distances between all pairs of strings are non-negative and do not exceed 10**5.

preconditions.expression: any(h(si, sj) > 0 for si in [s1, s2, s3, s4] for sj in [s1, s2, s3, s4] if si != sj)
preconditions.description: At least one number h(si, sj) is positive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(si) == len(sj) for si in [s1, s2, s3, s4] for sj in [s1, s2, s3, s4] if si != sj)

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output['len'] is not None and output['len'] > 0 and all(len(s) == output['len'] for s in output['strings']))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 or a list of four strings of equal length.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(h(s1, s2) == h(output['strings'][0], output['strings'][1]) and h(s1, s3) == h(output['strings'][0], output['strings'][2]) and h(s1, s4) == h(output['strings'][0], output['strings'][3]) and h(s2, s3) == h(output['strings'][1], output['strings'][2]) and h(s2, s4) == h(output['strings'][1], output['strings'][3]) and h(s3, s4) == h(output['strings'][2], output['strings'][3]) for s1, s2, s3, s4 in itertools.permutations(output['strings'], 4))
postconditions.description: The output strings have the same pairwise Hamming distances as the input strings.
